layer: nested KWin virtual backend + nested Xwayland (not physical)

kwinNativeBehaviour.note: Measured in a nested KWin without Plastile (the same steps as the Plastile run); Plastile's run matched it at every step.
kwinNativeBehaviour.xParentMovedToDesktop2: the X dialog moves to desktop 2 with its parent (as the Wayland transient does)
kwinNativeBehaviour.xDialogSentAlone: only the X dialog moves; the parent stays

mutationChecks.note: Each mutation was applied to src/, rebuilt, run once in a nested session and reverted (dirty tree); the counts are failed checks.

classify: the dialog and transient rules.xtransient-parent-*-T16: 0 failed: the window-type rule still floats an X11 dialog-typed window, so the mutation needed that rule too

float capture skipped while suspended, w.resume-floats-T19: 0 failed: floats are not context members, so restoreFloatRects writes none, and toggling a float to tile re-captures its live frame; the user-visible outcome is unchanged

observations: Toggle floating while suspended is rejected with `tiling suspended` (documented in docs/user/SHORTCUTS.md); a float made while suspended is honoured when it is KWin's own quick tile (an explicit native placement, BEHAVIOR §9).

A float moved by the user while Plastile was disabled is put back at the rectangle saved at unload on re-enable (one restore write). Saved floats are keyed by application identity, never by window (src/persist/match.ts), so the new runtime cannot tell this live window from a reopened one. Recorded, not asserted: {"frame": {"x": 640, "y": 300, "width": 460, "height": 340}, "saved": {"x": 640, "y": 300, "width": 460, "height": 340}, "moved": {"x": 420, "y": 210, "width": 500, "height": 360}, "keptLive": false, "restoredSaved": true, "writes": 1}

A float of an application with several open windows is not restored after re-enable (Q06, documented in docs/user/TROUBLESHOOTING.md); the scenario gives its restored floats their own app ids for that reason.
